shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Use the theme token (e.g. bg-*/text-* names from styles.css), or declare a new --color-* there. ADR-002.

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: Prefer the theme scale — move off-token values to a token when the design calls for one.

shadcn/no-restyle.message: Kumo primitives own their look — prefer size/variant props over visual restyling. ADR-002.
